concretechanges.before: Read as a diagnostic rather than a stopwatch, the yugas describe four conditions of relation.
concretechanges.after: In the reading developed here, the yugas offer four conditions of relation. This is an interpretive use of cosmological time, rather than a diagnosis of people or periods.

concretechanges.before: The triad prevents a common spiritual escape. Kha without Ba becomes abstraction. Ba without Kha becomes mere mechanism. Both without La become fantasy, because nothing pushes back.
concretechanges.after: The triad is a house lens for keeping observation, embodied life and material resistance in view. It is useful while it helps the inquiry remain answerable to what pushes back.

concretechanges.before:
The work is therefore neither dissolution nor obedience. It is cartography with accountability. Name the field. Name the boundary. Ask what crosses it. Ask who benefits from its permanence. Then notice what the body already knows before the map explains it away.

**Distinction is a tool; severance is the error.**

*Self-Consciousness as Technology. Body as Medium. Breath as Interface.*
concretechanges.after: Cartography with accountability returns to the ground: who sets this boundary, what may cross it, and who bears its permanence? The map can be revised without pretending the injury or the watershed disappears with the line.
